name: GotoObject
description: Allows the agent to set its pose to anywhere in the scene in a single step.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target place to move to. It can be an objectId or a place name.

name: PickupObject
description: Pick up an interactable object specified by its objectId. Compatible objects have 'pickupable' as True in their metadata.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target object's objectId, found in the object's metadata.

name: PutObject
description: PutObject attempts to put an object the agent is holding onto or into the target receptacle. Valid target receptacle objects have receptacle as True in their object metadata.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target receptacle's objectId of the object in hand to put in or on.

name: OpenObject
description: Attempts to open an Openable object to a specified amount, parameterized by openness. The full list of openable object types can be filtered on the Object Types page.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target object's objectId, found in the object's metadata.

parameters.name: openness
parameters.description: The proportion regarding how far the object should open. Valid values are in [0:1][0:1][0:1], where the value 000 corresponds to completely closed, 111 corresponds to completely open, and 0.50.50.5 corresponds to halfway open, for instance.

name: CloseObject
description: Closes an object specified by its objectId. The object must be within the agent's initialized visibilityDistance and appear in the agent's current frame.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target object's objectId, found in the object's metadata.

name: SliceObject
description: Attempts to slice an object. If an object, such as an Apple, is successfully sliced, there may include several new AppleSliced objects in the scene and metadata, one for each slice. Other objects, like Egg, may only break after being sliced. Sliced objects cannot be unsliced (unless the scene is reset).

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target object's objectId, found in the object's metadata.

name: ToggleObjectOn
description: Toggles an object between on states. Examples include Lamps, Light Switches, Stove Knobs, and Laptops.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target object's objectId, found in the object's metadata.

name: ToggleObjectOff
description: Toggles an object between off states. Examples include Lamps, Light Switches, Stove Knobs, and Laptops.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The target object's objectId, found in the object's metadata.

name: Done
description: The 'Done' api indicates the episode is over. All tasks have been completed.
